a: find . -name '*.py' lists Python files under the current tree.
xargs passes stdin items as arguments to another command.
cmd1 | cmd2 sends stdout of cmd1 to stdin of cmd2.
> overwrites a file; >> appends; 2> redirects stderr.
chmod +x script.sh makes a script executable.
ssh user@host opens a secure shell session.
scp file user@host:path copies over SSH.
tar -czf archive.tar.gz dir packs and compresses a directory.
journalctl -u service shows logs for a systemd unit.
